'''Betterlife Pharmaceuticals''' was a pharmaceutical company that was in actuality a front company for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Located in the [[Lower Industrial Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Betterlife was manned by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]], but [[Damrosch]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] convinced [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces to raid Betterlife and recover proof of its Imperial ties.
